label: Normal weekday
about: Traffic from JICA's 2022 weekday counts, no rain.

label: Rain of 10 Aug 2025
about: Normal traffic with that day's real rain, hour by hour (Open-Meteo archive). In rain, drivers go slower and leave longer gaps, so each green moves up to 19% fewer vehicles.

label: Heavy rain 17:00-19:00
about: A what-if: normal traffic with 15 mm of rain an hour from 17:00 to 19:00. In rain, drivers go slower and leave longer gaps, so each green moves up to 19% fewer vehicles.

label: Water Festival
about: Assumed pattern: traffic towards the centre and the riverside x1.4 from 15:00.

label: Holiday exodus
about: Assumed pattern for the day before Khmer New Year or Pchum Ben: traffic leaving the centre x1.5 from 12:00 to 21:00.
